item.description:
Flow 3.8.0

Flow 3.8.0 adds named download queues with independent start/stop controls, daily windows, concurrency limits and safe reassignment. Existing history migrates into Main queue; queue operations preserve partial bytes and manually paused downloads.

Rolling payload quotas persist usage across restarts and resume queued files when allowance renews. Available periods are 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days. In-flight data can slightly exceed the allowance; accounting uses conservative one-minute buckets.

Download networking now supports macOS system proxies, direct connections, explicit HTTP proxies and SOCKS5 endpoints. Credentials and authenticated proxies are not implemented yet. Changes apply to new/resumed transfers.

Website link discovery offers bounded static-page traversal, extension filters, a selectable preview and a saved project. It does not yet render JavaScript pages or mirror websites for offline use.

Browser setup adds Edge and a Firefox development package alongside Chrome. Firefox permanent installation requires Mozilla signing; Safari integration, browser-session authentication, and streaming playlist downloads remain pending. No additional Chrome permissions are requested.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization pending.

Flow 3.7.0

Flow 3.7.0 fixes GET-only signed download URLs that reject HEAD requests, including APKMirror. It also adds dynamic redistribution of unfinished byte ranges, configurable connection and queue concurrency, download properties with safe filename editing and notes, and text-file link import/export. The default remains eight connections and automatic reductions are disabled.

Chrome extension 2.2.0 adds optional file-type capture filters and site exclusions without additional permissions.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization pending.

Flow 3.6.4

Flow 3.6.4 preserves the filename provided by Chrome, including spaces and file extensions. Browser capture connection repairs and popup status are included.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization pending.
